description.ES: Terminas el grado. Puedes estudiar un máster de dos años o empezar a trabajar ya.
description.EN: You are finishing your bachelor's. You can study a two-year master's or start working now.

sources: Tuition 8,000 CHF/year for 2 years: scenario-assumptions.csv (AS-P00001-01/02), illustrative, not verified.
Salaries: synthetic-profiles.csv, employed net income p10 ≈ 4,560 and median ≈ 7,740 CHF/month; junior salaries set below the median (assumption).
Job-search delays and the scholarship in the optimistic case are assumptions.
Current income, rent and living cost: Alexia's profile and her 24-month ledger.

narrative.ES: La matrícula sube un 10 % y, al terminar, tardas seis meses en encontrar trabajo. Empiezas con 5.000 CHF al mes.
narrative.EN: Tuition goes up 10% and, after graduating, it takes you six months to find a job. You start at CHF 5,000 a month.

narrative.ES: Pagas 8.000 CHF al año de matrícula. Dos meses después de graduarte empiezas a trabajar con 6.000 CHF al mes.
narrative.EN: You pay CHF 8,000 a year in tuition. Two months after graduating you start working at CHF 6,000 a month.

narrative.ES: Consigues una beca que cubre la mitad de la matrícula y una oferta antes de graduarte: 7.000 CHF al mes.
narrative.EN: You win a scholarship covering half the tuition and get an offer before graduating: CHF 7,000 a month.

narrative.ES: Tardas cuatro meses en encontrar trabajo y empiezas con 4.200 CHF al mes.
narrative.EN: It takes you four months to find a job and you start at CHF 4,200 a month.

narrative.ES: En dos meses encuentras trabajo con 4.800 CHF al mes.
narrative.EN: Within two months you find a job paying CHF 4,800 a month.

narrative.ES: Te contratan en tus prácticas al mes siguiente, con 5.400 CHF al mes.
narrative.EN: Your internship hires you the following month at CHF 5,400 a month.

description.ES: Estás pagando intereses por el descubierto. Puedes pedir un préstamo personal o pedir ayuda a tu familia.
description.EN: You are paying interest on the overdraft. You can take out a personal loan or ask your family for help.

sources: Loan rates: synthetic-liabilities.csv, personal loans from 2.53% (min) to 8.48% (max), median 5.82%.
Overdraft interest: 8.5%/year, the maximum loan rate in the dataset (assumption, see Assumptions.financingRateAnnual).
Loan amount (30,000 CHF over 60 months) and family help amounts are assumptions.

narrative.ES: El banco te presta 30.000 CHF, pero al 8,5 %: la cuota es alta durante cinco años.
narrative.EN: The bank lends you CHF 30,000, but at 8.5%: a high monthly payment for five years.

narrative.ES: Consigues un préstamo de 30.000 CHF al 5,8 % a cinco años.
narrative.EN: You get a CHF 30,000 loan at 5.8% over five years.

narrative.ES: Tu nuevo contrato convence al banco: 30.000 CHF al 2,5 % a cinco años.
narrative.EN: Your new contract convinces the bank: CHF 30,000 at 2.5% over five years.

narrative.ES: Tu familia solo puede darte 5.000 CHF. El resto sigue en descubierto, con intereses.
narrative.EN: Your family can only give you CHF 5,000. The rest stays overdrawn, with interest.

narrative.ES: Tu familia te da 15.000 CHF sin intereses.
narrative.EN: Your family gives you CHF 15,000, interest-free.

narrative.ES: Tu familia cubre todo el descubierto: 30.000 CHF.
narrative.EN: Your family covers the whole overdraft: CHF 30,000.
